ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-12-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day.
Commissioner Sue Kaplan, Clerks: S. Ravinantapricha/V. Mack, CSR: Deborah Neville.
Petitioner, Adela del Carmen Ramos Hernandez, the minor's mother, present in pro per, was sworn and examined.
The Court grants the petition for change of name of minor to Elizabeth Jasmen Hernandez Ramos.
Decree signed in open court.
